zh.title: AI脑波英语样板店怎么开：学习舱、标准教室和机器人教练如何组合
zh.description: 教育机构和创业者引入AI脑波英语，不是只买几台学习舱，而是搭建一套可复制的校区模型：测评咨询、桌椅预习区、学习舱训练区、出舱复现区、真人教练和具身智能机器人教练协同。
zh.lead: AI脑波英语样板店的关键，不是把学习舱摆进教室，而是把家长进店、学生测评、桌椅区预习、学习舱训练、出舱检测、复现巩固和后续课程服务组织成一条可复制的交付线。

sections.h2: 为什么教育机构需要的是“校区模型”，不是单一设备？
paragraphs: 很多机构做新项目时容易把注意力放在设备上，但真正决定口碑的，是家长到店后能不能看懂流程，学生训练后能不能当场复现，教练能不能把结果转化成后续学习计划。
AI脑波英语适合做成“学习舱 + 标准桌椅区 + 教练服务 + 课程体系”的综合空间。学习舱负责高效率输入，桌椅区负责测评、读熟、检测、复现和专项训练，真人教练负责解释与服务，机器人教练未来可用于标准化带训和互动。
bullets: 家长看得懂：先测评，再解释孩子卡点，不直接推大课。
学生能感知：进舱前读熟，出舱后读、认、听、复现。
教练能执行：每节课有记录、有检测、有下一步安排。
机构能复制：空间、人员、体验课、转化和续学动作都标准化。

sections.h2: 一个标准校区应该有哪些功能区？
paragraphs: 建议把校区拆成四个核心区：前台与家长等待区、30分钟测评咨询区、桌椅预习与复现区、学习舱训练区。空间不必一开始很大，但动线必须清楚。
桌椅区不能被忽略。AI脑波英语不是让孩子一直躺着，而是先在桌椅区完成音标、自然拼读、词汇读熟和测评，再进入学习舱做节律化输入，出来后再回到桌椅区检测、复现、纠错和讲解。
bullets: 测评咨询区：承接家长信任，讲清孩子的真实基础。
桌椅预习区：完成读熟、音标、自然拼读、词义理解。
学习舱训练区：眼罩、耳机和课程内容形成稳定输入环境。
复现检测区：出舱后马上看孩子能否读出、认出、听出、说出。

sections.h2: 真人教练和具身智能机器人教练分别做什么？
paragraphs: 当前阶段，真人教练仍然是服务质量的核心。教练要能带学生读熟、记录错词、观察状态、讲解检测结果，并协助咨询老师完成家长沟通。
下一代校区会逐步引入具身智能机器人教练。它不是替代真人老师，而是承担重复性带训、标准话术提示、复习互动和数据采集，让校区服务更稳定，也让加盟商更容易复制。
bullets: 真人教练：负责温度、判断、服务和个体调整。
机器人教练：负责标准流程、互动复习、数据记录和演示感。
AI学习软件：把学习舱、词汇课程、复习任务和检测结果连接起来。
校区负责人：盯获客、到店、体验、成交、续学和口碑素材。

sections.h2: 合作机构60天内应该先跑通什么？
paragraphs: 第一阶段不要急着做大规模复制，应该先跑通一个样板校区。重点不是喊口号，而是看每天能不能稳定带来到店，家长是否愿意体验，学生是否能在现场看到变化，教练是否能把每节课交付完整。
合作模式可以理解为：机构负责场地、团队和生源；AI脑波英语负责设备、课程、培训和交付标准；双方围绕设备保证金和流水分账设计合作机制。具体商务条款以正式沟通为准。
bullets: 第1-15天：完成空间、人员、物料、话术和体验课流程搭建。
第16-30天：用地推、自媒体、电话外呼和渠道合作测试到店。
第31-45天：沉淀前测、训练、出舱检测、家长反馈和口碑素材。
第46-60天：复盘单校区获客成本、成交率、课消、续学和团队能力。

faqs.q: AI脑波英语样板店只需要摆学习舱吗？
faqs.a: 不是。学习舱只是训练环节之一，还需要测评咨询、桌椅预习、出舱检测、复现巩固、专项训练和家长沟通，才能形成完整交付。

faqs.q: 机构合作需要自己研发课程吗？
faqs.a: 一般不需要从零研发。机构负责场地、团队和生源，AI脑波英语负责设备、课程、培训和服务标准，具体合作机制需要单独沟通。

faqs.q: 具身智能机器人教练现在就必须配置吗？
faqs.a: 不是必须。当前可以先用真人教练跑通服务，机器人教练属于下一代校区的科技展示和标准化交付方向。

faqs.q: 合作机构第一阶段最应该验证什么？
faqs.a: 先验证到店、体验、出舱检测、家长反馈、成交和教练交付，不建议一开始就用大规模复制替代单店验证。

zh.cta: 如果你是教育机构负责人、学习中心老板或正在找教育项目的创业者，可以先预约一次机构合作沟通，了解样板店空间、设备、课程、培训和分账模型。

en.title: How to Set Up an AI Brainwave English Center: Cabins, Classroom and Robot Coach
en.description: AI Brainwave English centers combine assessment, classroom desks, learning cabins, exit testing, human coaches and future embodied AI robot coaches into a repeatable model for education partners.
en.lead: An AI Brainwave English center is not just a room with learning cabins. It is a repeatable service model that connects parent consultation, assessment, classroom preparation, cabin-based input, exit testing, review and follow-up programs.

sections.h2: Why partners need a center model, not just a device
paragraphs: Education centers often focus on equipment when adding a new program, but parent trust comes from the full experience: what is assessed, how the student trains, what is tested after the session, and how the coach explains the next step.

The AI Brainwave English model combines learning cabins, a standard classroom area, human coaching and a course system. The cabin supports focused input, while desks and chairs support assessment, reading preparation, testing, review and exam-oriented transfer.
bullets: Parents understand the process: assessment first, then a suitable training path.
Students see evidence: pronunciation, recognition, listening and recall after the session.
Coaches can deliver: every session has records, testing and a next-step plan.
Centers can replicate: space, staffing, trial lessons, conversion and follow-up are standardized.

sections.h2: What zones should a standard center include?
paragraphs: A practical center can be organized into four zones: reception and parent waiting, 30-minute assessment consultation, classroom preparation and recall, and learning cabin training. The space does not need to be large at the beginning, but the service flow must be clear.

The classroom area matters. AI Brainwave English is not about having students lie down for the entire session. Students first work on phonics, pronunciation, word meaning and preparation at desks, then enter the cabin, and return to the classroom area for exit testing and review.
bullets: Assessment zone: build trust by identifying the student’s real barriers.
Preparation zone: phonics, pronunciation and vocabulary readiness.
Learning cabin zone: headset, eye mask and structured course input.
Recall zone: test whether the student can read, recognize, hear and reproduce words.

sections.h2: What do human coaches and embodied AI robot coaches each do?
paragraphs: At this stage, human coaches remain central to service quality. They guide preparation, record difficult words, observe learning status, explain test results and support parent communication.

In the next-generation center, embodied AI robot coaches can help with repetitive guidance, standardized prompts, review interaction and data capture. The goal is not to remove human service, but to make the delivery more consistent and scalable.
bullets: Human coach: judgment, warmth, service and individual adjustment.
Robot coach: standardized workflow, review interaction, data capture and demonstration value.
AI learning software: connects cabins, course content, review tasks and testing records.
Center manager: tracks acquisition, visits, trials, conversion, renewal and proof materials.

sections.h2: What should a partner validate in the first 60 days?
paragraphs: The first stage should focus on one pilot center instead of broad promises. The key is whether the center can bring in parents, create a convincing trial, record the training process, show visible exit-test evidence and deliver follow-up programs consistently.

A typical cooperation model can be understood as: the partner provides space, team and student acquisition; AI Brainwave English provides equipment, course system, training and delivery standards. Equipment deposit and revenue sharing can be discussed case by case.
bullets: Days 1-15: space, team, materials, scripts and trial lesson setup.
Days 16-30: test acquisition through local promotion, short videos, phone outreach and channel partners.
Days 31-45: collect assessment records, training evidence, exit testing and parent feedback.
Days 46-60: review unit economics, conversion, course delivery, renewal and team capability.

faqs.q: Is a learning cabin enough to open a center?
faqs.a: No. A full center also needs assessment, classroom preparation, exit testing, review, coaching and parent communication.

faqs.q: Does a partner need to build its own curriculum?
faqs.a: Usually not from scratch. The partner focuses on space, team and acquisition, while AI Brainwave English provides equipment, course system, training and delivery standards.

faqs.q: Is an embodied AI robot coach required on day one?
faqs.a: No. Human coaches can run the service first. Robot coaches are part of the next-generation center direction for demonstration and standardization.
Visit generation, trial experience, exit-test evidence, parent feedback, conversion and coach delivery should be validated before large-scale rollout.

en.cta: If you operate an education center or are looking for an AI education project, schedule a partnership discussion to review the center layout, equipment, course system, training and revenue-sharing model.
